standard: Separate cutoff facts from later outcomes; observation is not prediction

cases.subject: HiTDOC / EDF 2022
cases.claim_under_test: Отбор HiTDOC на EDF 2022 приведёт к подписанному грантовому соглашению.

cutoff_source.observation: 41 proposal selected for funding, and the EDF 2022 HiTDOC project listed; project factsheets represent invitations to grant-preparation, with no contractual commitment by Commission.

later_outcome.observation: Commission explicitly named HiTDOC among the five signed technological challenge grant agreements.

cases.allowed_cutoff_inference: Selection is a real funding-pipeline milestone; grant signature remains contingent.
cases.unsupported_cutoff_inference: The contract was already signed; counter-IED tools were fielded or delivered.
cases.disconfirming_test: Commission explicitly declines grant agreement, project withdrawn or no signature by a preregistered date.
cases.evidence_scope: Two date-labelled Commission web publications, historical content snapshot NOT verified.

cases.subject: EDIRPA
cases.claim_under_test: Предложение EDIRPA на €500 млн превратится в принятый регламент с тем же бюджетом.

cutoff_source.observation: Commission adopted a proposal for EDIRPA, requesting €500m of EU budget to incentivise common procurement, not a passed Regulation.

later_outcome.observation: Council adopted EDIRPA regulation, but the instrument budget was €300m, not proposed €500m.

cases.allowed_cutoff_inference: Institutional initiative toward common procurement exists, €500m is only the proposed envelope.
cases.unsupported_cutoff_inference: Final EU commitment of €500m; procurement contracts already awarded or goods delivered.
cases.disconfirming_test: Proposal dropped, no regulation by fixed horizon; final appropriation differs from proposed amount.
cases.metric_boundary: proposal_€500m vs adopted_budget_€300m vs spending vs delivery
cases.evidence_scope: Dated original Commission and Council news; archival snapshot at cutoff not certified.

cases.subject: European Peace Facility (EPF) ceiling
cases.claim_under_test: Политическое соглашение Совета о повышении потолка EPF будет формализовано решением в 2023 году.

cutoff_source.observation: Council reached political agreement on €2bn increase measured in 2018 prices, said it would be formalised in early 2023.

later_outcome.observation: Council adopted decision, resulting total ceiling €7.979bn in current prices until 2027; implements December 2022 political agreement.

cases.allowed_cutoff_inference: Political intent to increase off-budget ceiling with a specifically described formal decision pending.
cases.unsupported_cutoff_inference: An immediate €2bn disbursement, same-number comparison across price bases, or an immediate transfer of weapons.
cases.disconfirming_test: No implementing decision within preregistered horizon, materially different legislative ceiling.
cases.metric_boundary: 2018_euros vs current_euros; financial_ceiling vs disbursement vs delivery
cases.evidence_scope: Date-stamped Council statements. Independent archive timestamp unavailable.

cases.subject: Finland NATO accession
cases.claim_under_test: Подписание протоколов присоединения Финляндии ведёт к полноценному членству в НАТО.

cutoff_source.observation: Allies signed accession protocols for Finland and Sweden; national ratification and accession remained future steps.

later_outcome.observation: Finland deposited instrument of accession and became NATO's 31st member on 4 April 2023.

cases.allowed_cutoff_inference: Formal institutional accession process advanced, but ratification was not complete.
cases.unsupported_cutoff_inference: Finland already became member on 5 July 2022, or exact accession date was known then.
cases.disconfirming_test: Ratification blocked or invitation lapsed before preregistered horizon.
cases.evidence_scope: Two dated NATO news releases; contemporary 2022 snapshot not independently certified.

cases.subject: FARA future reconnaissance aircraft
cases.sector: US Army procurement and defence industry
cases.claim_under_test: Выявленные GAO технические и бюджетные риски FARA указывают на повышенный риск программы, а не гарантируют отмену.

cutoff_source.observation: GAO documented risk in Future Vertical Lift portfolio, non-credible cost estimates, insufficient technology demonstrations. FARA was targeting an aircraft in 2030; 2023 document did not announce cancellation.
cutoff_source.warning: GAO webpage has later-updated recommendation statuses; do not replay today's whole HTML as 2023.

later_outcome.observation: US Army announced that FARA development would end at conclusion of FY2024 prototyping; official reason includes affordability and rebalancing toward other assets.

cases.allowed_cutoff_inference: Acquisition execution risk is substantial and warrants monitoring; probability of cancellation is not quantified.
cases.unsupported_cutoff_inference: 2023 GAO already proves FARA will be cancelled, or all Future Vertical Lift programs are cancelled.
cases.disconfirming_test: Risk mitigation and stable acquisition milestones maintained during preregistered horizon.
cases.metric_boundary: GAO_early_risk vs procurement_decision vs prototype vs fielded_aircraft
cases.evidence_scope: GAO 2023 report/GAO html with retrospective updates; Army original 2024 press release. Cutoff evidence should be frozen from report, not later updated GAO page.
